description: Machine-readable LoveTypes safety boundary index for reflection, consent, privacy, and urgent-risk use cases.

saferFirstSteps.label: Use a free repair task before buying.
Check data and local storage boundaries.
Report unclear pages, links, or supply requests.

body.zh: LoveTypes 的測驗、守護者與心語庭園是關係反思與溝通練習，不提供心理諮商、醫療、法律或個別關係診斷。
body.en: LoveTypes quizzes, guardians, and the Heart Garden are for relationship reflection and communication practice, not therapy, medical advice, legal advice, or individual diagnosis.

body.zh: 若關係中有暴力、控制、創傷、騷擾、自傷風險或緊急危險，請先尋求當地緊急資源、可信任的人與專業支援。
body.en: If there is violence, coercive control, trauma, harassment, self-harm risk, or urgent danger, seek local emergency resources, trusted people, and professional support first.

title.en: Do not use exercises to replace repair

body.zh: 網站上的測驗、句型與工作表只能協助整理想法，不能取代道歉、同意、界線協商或持續行動，也不應被用來逼迫對方改變。
body.en: Quizzes, scripts, and worksheets can organize thoughts, but cannot replace apology, consent, boundary negotiation, or sustained action, and must not be used to pressure someone to change.

body.zh: 補給願望清單與回報信箱不需要測驗分數、敏感個資或緊急求助內容；請只留下守護者、使用情境與你希望修復或收到的素材。
body.en: Supply waitlist and repair inbox emails do not need quiz scores, sensitive personal details, or emergency requests. Include only the guardian, use case, and the material or issue you want handled.
